title: Metrics, Fairness, and Monitoring
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of precision/recall tradeoffs, drift, and human review, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in credit-card-fraud-detection.
learning_objectives: Explain precision/recall tradeoffs, drift, and human review in plain language and connect it to tests/test_flask.py; src/train.py.
Trace one input through the metrics, fairness, and monitoring stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: precision/recall tradeoffs, drift, and human review
practical_outcomes: Trace the metrics, fairness, and monitoring stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for precision/recall tradeoffs, drift, and human review.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
